sources.quote: TP-Link proposes $1 billion US Wi-Fi router manufacturing alliance with Key Tronic
TP-Link tries to appease Trump admin with pledge to assemble routers in US

claims.statement: TP-Link proposed a $1 billion US manufacturing alliance with Key Tronic to assemble routers in the US.

sources.quote: TP-Link is at the mercy of the FCC regarding its ready-to-go Wi-Fi 8 routers, so it has a sweetener in mind to move things along.
TP-Link can't sell latest routers in US despite rivals getting FCC approvals.

claims.statement: The move is meant to help win FCC approval for its Wi-Fi 8 routers, which it cannot currently sell in the US while rivals have been approved.

analysis.headline: TP-Link proposes US router manufacturing deal to win FCC approval
analysis.summary: TP-Link has proposed a $1 billion alliance with Key Tronic to assemble Wi-Fi routers in the US, an apparent bid to win over regulators after the FCC left its newest routers blocked from sale in the US while rivals received approval.
